hni_signals: Very senior, late-career academic-turned-private cardiologist. Held a full academic post - Assistant Professor of Medicine then of Cardiology at Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS), Hyderabad, for roughly 17 years (1976-1993) - before moving into corporate private practice. Held consultant posts across three major Hyderabad corporate hospital groups in succession: Mediciti Hospitals (1993-1997), CARE Hospitals (1993-2019, a ~26-year tenure) and now AIG Hospitals (from October 2019). Trained at the state's flagship public institutions (Kakatiya Medical College, Osmania Medical College, NIMS).
